relevance_note: Supplementary Table 1 gives sex, age, symptoms and medication for 16 named patients (P3-P22) described as "patients with HA20"; no TNFAIP3 variant is printed.
method_note: Microbiome study of 16 previously reported Japanese HA20 patients (IDs same as Kadowaki et al. 2018) and 15 relatives. Individual-level data come only from Supplementary Table 1 (DataSheet_1.docx), transcribed with a short Python script whose spans are row prefixes from the ID cell through the cited cell; output checked against the table. Labels are the paper's own IDs (e.g. 'P3', 'P3-fa', 'P8/P9-mo'). The 15 healthy relatives were included as relatives described in relation to named patients (testing status not stated; one sibling 'whose genetic information is unknown' is not identified); they get no variant rows and no features except P22-sib (food allergies). No variant rows: the paper prints no TNFAIP3 variant and does not explicitly attribute a TNFAIP3 variant to each patient (it calls them 'patients with HA20'). 'Age' in the table is age at sample collection, recorded as age at last evaluation; ISO in years from the text ('19 (3–43) ... years', 'younger than 3 years old'). Stomatitis yes/no and abdominal symptoms yes/no are recorded as features. Checklist: 'oral ulcers' excluded only where stomatitis is 'no' (absence of stomatitis taken as covering oral ulcers); stomatitis 'yes' left oral ulcers 'not reported' (stomatitis is not necessarily ulceration); abdominal symptoms not mapped to GI inflammation. Severity class (mild/moderate/severe, study-defined) not recorded as a feature. '-' cells for relatives are undefined symbols, so not reported; NA not reported. 'Nobody but ... (P22-sib) has food allergies' was not used to exclude food allergy for others (group not named). Autoantibody status is given only as counts (4 with, 5 without), so not assigned. No stacked cells. No contradictions found.
